type
unique
as other arr 0.:int=1 0.:str="a"
difference $other
intersect $other
difference $other
as none arr
intersect $none
difference $none
unique @none
as m1 obj a 0.:int=1 b 0.:int=2 c 0.:int=3
as m2 obj b 0.:str="two" d 0.:int=4
merge @m1 $m2
merge @m2 $m1
as empty obj
merge @m1 $empty
merge @empty $empty
merge $m1
unique @m1
